deoxygenation_method: Offline argon sparging of EtOH and pH 9 buffer (≥20 min, fine frit) prior to feed preparation; feed solution prepared and stored under argon in sealed reservoir with argon headspace during pumping; no inline degasser (hard constraint)

topology_operations.label: Pump A — Single pre-mixed, pre-degassed feed containing substrate, Michael acceptor, and photocatalyst in EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v). All components are compatible in the absence of O₂. Pre-degassed offline with argon sparging and stored under argon headspace.
PhotoCoil — Giese radical addition (C–C bond formation)

MFC B — Air introduced via the interstage air-liquid T-mixer and MFC. Provides O₂ for both SET (superoxide) and EnT (singlet oxygen) sulfoxidation pathways. Segmented gas-liquid (Taylor) flow enhances O₂ mass transfer in 1 mm ID FEP coil.
